item.title: 'They're stealing from the poor': A major source of SNAP fraud robs recipients of millions
item.description: Organized criminal rings target SNAP recipients because of the government program's outdated security features. But upgrading the tech costs money and states' SNAP budgets are getting squeezed.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: In Kansas, a newly-competitive Senate race tests limit of Trump's unpopular policies
item.description: Kansas voters could send a Democrat to the Senate for the first time in nearly a century — and flip the governor's office back to Republican control, even in what could be a tough year for the GOP.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Labor Department to release latest inflation report
item.description: Higher energy prices, tied to the U.S. war with Iran, are driving up the overall cost-of-living. The Labor Department is set to deliver its latest inflation report this morning.
item.content:encoded: Higher energy prices, tied to the U.S. war with Iran, are driving up the overall cost-of-living. The Labor Department is set to deliver its latest inflation report this morning.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
item.description: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Naturalization in the U.S. is on the decline
item.description: The number of naturalization ceremonies for would-be American citizens is on the decline. This year, ceremonies have been canceled and citizenship applications face increased scrutiny and delays.

item.description: Six Democratic and six Republican senators wrote a letter calling on President Trump to withdraw from his recent deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

item.title: A judge blocks the government's tree-clearing spree at a municipal D.C. golf course
item.description: Locals and preservationists have long opposed Trump's plan to redevelop a municipal D.C. golf course. That legal fight escalated after the government cleared hundreds of trees on short notice.

item.title: Cornell University bans frat parties, vows to address 'disturbing' campus culture
item.description: In a letter, Cornell's president apologized for what happened to the student who alleges she was raped by several men at a fraternity house in 2024 and promised 'meaningful action.'

item.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
item.description: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.
